notes: Expanded MAINT-ARCH to full story set (schema, core logic, API/facade, integration, tests).

change_log.note: Connects layers and preserves runtime behavior

MAINT-ARCH-S1.title: Define Service Boundaries and Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S1.description: Define and document service interfaces, input/output schemas, and boundaries across the 4-layer modular monolith (facades, domain services, infrastructure). Ensure strict contracts between FindCare, EvaluateCare, and Shared services per ARCH-001.

MAINT-ARCH-S2.title: Refactor Domain Logic into Modular Services
MAINT-ARCH-S2.description: Extract and reorganize existing business logic into discrete domain services (provider_search, specialty, clinical_trials, provider_detail, consent, safety, etc.) aligned to ARCH-001, removing cross-layer leakage and enforcing service isolation.

MAINT-ARCH-S3.title: Align Facades and API Entrypoints
MAINT-ARCH-S3.description: Refactor application facades (find_care_facade, evaluate_care_facade) and FastAPI entrypoints to call newly modularized services while preserving external API behavior and tool_router compatibility.

MAINT-ARCH-S4.title: Implement Layer Integration and Dependency Wiring
MAINT-ARCH-S4.description: Wire together facades, domain services, and infrastructure components using clear dependency flow (no circular dependencies), ensuring configuration, service initialization, and runtime orchestration match ARCH-001 design.

MAINT-ARCH-S5.title: Validate Refactor with Unit and Integration Tests
MAINT-ARCH-S5.description: Update and expand unit, integration, and regression tests to validate service isolation, facade orchestration, and strict behavioral parity with the pre-refactor baseline (including E2E regression expectations and UAT scenarios).
